name: live2d-character
description: Live2D 角色立繪標準拆層（對應 live2d-template-spec §4a）。desc 寫成通用 anime 描述，可重用於任何正面立繪角色。
notes: z 越小越後（先畫）。type=complete 的件要求把被遮處 inpaint 補完。眼睛細件(white/iris/highlight/lid/lash)與共用 overlay 不在此 preset，建議拆層後在 Photoshop 手工細分/手繪。

parts.desc: the long back hair behind the head and shoulders

parts.occluder: the cape/outer garment and any hair
parts.desc: the torso and neck (the inner top/clothing the character wears)
the character's left arm and sleeve
the character's right arm and sleeve
the outer garment / cape / capelet worn over the shoulders
the full face and head skin (forehead, cheeks, chin, nose, ears, neck)
the blush marks on the cheeks (if any)
the character's left eye (iris, eye white, eyelid and lashes together)
the character's right eye (iris, eye white, eyelid and lashes together)
the left side lock of hair framing the face
the right side lock of hair framing the face
the front hair / bangs over the forehead
the hair clip / hair accessory (if any)
